map.：本站气压 900 hPa：气压高度≈(1−(900/1013.25)^0.19: Station pressure 900 hPa: the barometric altitude is about (1 - (900/1013.25)^0.1903) x 44331 = about 990 m, close to the geometric elevation (in a standard atmosphere).
map.：实测气压低于标准 1013.25 → 高度表读数偏大，需 QNH 修正否则起飞: A measured pressure below the standard 1013.25 makes the altimeter read high, so without a QNH correction you would wrongly judge a high takeoff altitude.
map.气压高度=真实海拔吗？: Is Barometric Altitude the True Elevation?
map.仅标准大气下近似相等；真实大气冷暖偏差会使密度高度偏离几何高度，影响飞行。: They are approximately equal only in the standard atmosphere; real atmospheric temperature differences make the density altitude deviate from the geometric altitude, which affects flight.
map.为什么越高气压越低？: Why Does Pressure Drop with Altitude?
map.空气柱重量随高度减少，气压按指数衰减，每升约 5500 m 减半。: The weight of the air column falls with altitude and pressure decays exponentially, halving about every 5500 m of climb.
